purpose: Production plan, not generated/integrated/verified coverage. Coverage is maintained separately by the integration owner.

authorization.scope: All gameplay resource improvements, including new identity sprite frames when needed

identity_authority: Current assets/art/portraits/<id>.png pixels override historical batch images, family labels and incompatible descriptive equipment. Reinspect the exact reference before each generation.

provenance.route: Source-verified sprite-gen template-derived full prompt, adapted explicitly to native-alpha 3x2 generation through the built-in image tool; no external sprite-gen image API. Record any actually executed CLI preparation separately.
provenance.motion_prompt_role: Per-identity clauses in this plan are inputs to the full derived prompt, not standalone claims of CLI-generated sprite-gen prompts.
provenance.model_identifier: not exposed by built-in image tool; do not infer model tier from the reasoning model

shared_generation_contract.source_layout: 3 columns x 2 rows, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom; exact six complete poses
reference_lock: same identity, camera, facing, handedness, palette, silhouette vocabulary and equipment
genuine articulated changes, not six transforms of one still
no new scenery, text, visible guides, motion trails, projectiles, detached decoration or shadows
retain legitimate reference anatomy/attached ornaments; inspect known floating ornaments explicitly rather than discarding by component size alone
keep every weapon, wing, antler, tail and tentacle complete with safe padding

normalization.source_scale: one uniform scale per state row; retain cross-state apparent body size through stable anchor metadata
normalization.runtime_horizontal_anchor: ground-support/foot anchor, not changing weapon-inclusive bounding-box center
normalization.render_scale: calibrate once against the exact portrait; verify neutral size and baseline across states

attack.clock: During anticipation: clamp(0.18 - cooldown, 0, 0.18). At real attack event and after: 0.18 + (simulation.time - event.time). First immediate attack begins at frame 2, never delays damage.

walk.clock: Distance/speed-derived visual phase using actual progress; stun freezes locomotion; no simulation movement changes.
walk.facing: Preserve the fixed reference camera; never rotate an upright sprite 90 degrees at path corners.

idle.clock: simulation.time with deterministic display-only identity offset if needed; pause and reduced-motion freeze movement.
idle.fallback: Own portrait or own ready endpoint only, explicitly static and not counted as a generated idle row.

integration_contracts: A later idle import must merge with existing attack rows and preserve both; never overwrite the per-identity atlas/layout/receipt with only the new state.
Receipts retain provenance/checks/review per state, even when states share one atlas.
Runtime index schema 1 maps identities to atlas and frame_layout; validate each required state against actual layout rows and atlas pixels.
Missing or invalid identity state may use an explicitly tracked safe fallback but must not count as complete identity coverage.
Do not double-apply large procedural attack tilts to already articulated body frames.
Treat timing, damage, target selection, crowd control, RNG, save schema and cell movement as immutable gameplay contracts.
Generated, packed, integrated, image-reviewed and runtime-verified are separate coverage stages.

required_presentation_effects.enemy_hit: Actual affected identities, including splash targets; short bounded flash/recoil using own sprite.
required_presentation_effects.enemy_death: Presentation-only removal data before erasure; short own-sprite fade/collapse and optional family-appropriate particles; reward/death resolution unchanged.
required_presentation_effects.enemy_escape: Distinct exit feedback with no kill effect or reward.
required_presentation_effects.enemy_cc: Readable stun/slow feedback; movement phase matches the actual state.
required_presentation_effects.ally_placement: Ground-cell selection/drag/arrival feedback without inventing ally walking simulation.
required_presentation_effects.summon_combine: Bounded arrival/combination feedback; no HP or death state for consumed allies.
restrictions: All transients are bounded, unsaved and reset on restore/new run
Paused, backgrounded, speed-changed and reduced-motion behavior must match the game clock

memory_budget.budget_status: Engineering target, not a measured pass; excludes existing portraits, family fallbacks, backgrounds, render targets and importer/driver overhead.
memory_budget.loading_policy: Load identity atlases lazily. Release nonresident identities after no live unit, visible enemy, corpse/effect or preview references them. Clear caches on scene/run lifecycle boundaries as appropriate; lazy loading alone is not bounded across all waves.
memory_budget.future_resolution_policy: Retain 256px master assets; consider validated 128px variants for small on-screen sprites and 256px for bosses/large subjects. 128px cells quarter decoded atlas memory; adapt layout/anchor metadata rather than cropping. Measure readability and total Web/mobile GPU/RSS before adoption.

roadmap.goal: Core articulated combat and identity movement
roadmap.scope: attack for every ally and walk for every enemy; integrate validated batches cumulatively without marking remaining IDs complete
idle for every ally; preserve each existing attack row and cross-state continuity

roadmap.goal: Required presentation polish and final gates
roadmap.scope: hit/death/escape/CC/placement/summon/combine feedback, bounded resource residency, complete provenance and final native/Web verification

acceptance: Exact 87 identities and 121 required state rows, no duplicated/missing IDs or family-tint substitution counted as identity art
All six poses nonempty, in bounds, complete and visibly distinct where motion requires; no clipping, accidental duplicate frames or seam fragments
Stable identity, weapon/anatomy count, baseline and apparent body scale across each row and idle/attack transitions
Genuine six-phase movement/idle sequences; inspect complete loops, not one thumbnail
Attack impact starts on frame index 2 at real event, with 0.18s anticipation and 0.48s post-impact recovery
Representative runtime captures exercise all 34 attack identities and all 53 enemy identities with pause/speed/reduced-motion/restore cases
Splash hit/death, simultaneous kills, escape, victory cleanup and rapid repeated attacks preserve simulation and RNG
Art metadata paths point to the actual orthographic battlefield; static historical art is not counted as active coverage
Final VERIFY_VISUAL=1 bash scripts/verify.sh, export and browser QA results name the exact tested snapshot and remaining limits

idle.motion_prompt: Subtle chest breathing, a small relaxed elbow shift and cloth settling; sword remains lowered; return smoothly to the same ready pose.
